mapper.select: select from approval_instance where instance_id = #{instanceId} lock in share mode

select task_id, instance_id, node_id, node_order, node_code, node_name, task_status, approval_mode, required_count, completed_count, activated_time, completed_time, lock_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from approval_task where task_id = #{taskId}

select task_id, instance_id, node_id, node_order, node_code, node_name, task_status, approval_mode, required_count, completed_count, activated_time, completed_time, lock_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from approval_task where instance_id = #{instanceId} and task_status = 'WAITING' and node_order > #{afterOrder} order by node_order limit 1

select task_id, instance_id, node_id, node_order, node_code, node_name, task_status, approval_mode, required_count, completed_count, activated_time, completed_time, lock_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from approval_task where instance_id = #{instanceId} order by node_order, task_id

select candidate_id, task_id, instance_id, user_id, user_name, dept_id, dept_name, candidate_source_type, candidate_source_code, candidate_order, candidate_status, candidate_reason, acted_time, reassigned_from_candidate_id, lock_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from approval_task_candidate where task_id = #{taskId} order by candidate_order, candidate_id

select candidate_id, task_id, instance_id, user_id, user_name, dept_id, dept_name, candidate_source_type, candidate_source_code, candidate_order, candidate_status, candidate_reason, acted_time, reassigned_from_candidate_id, lock_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from approval_task_candidate where instance_id = #{instanceId} order by task_id, candidate_order, candidate_id

select candidate_id, task_id, instance_id, user_id, user_name, dept_id, dept_name, candidate_source_type, candidate_source_code, candidate_order, candidate_status, candidate_reason, acted_time, reassigned_from_candidate_id, lock_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from approval_task_candidate where task_id = #{taskId} and user_id = #{userId} and candidate_status = 'PENDING'

select candidate_id, task_id, instance_id, user_id, user_name, dept_id, dept_name, candidate_source_type, candidate_source_code, candidate_order, candidate_status, candidate_reason, acted_time, reassigned_from_candidate_id, lock_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from approval_task_candidate where candidate_id = #{candidateId}

select candidate_id, task_id, instance_id, user_id, user_name, dept_id, dept_name, candidate_source_type, candidate_source_code, candidate_order, candidate_status, candidate_reason, acted_time, reassigned_from_candidate_id, lock_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from approval_task_candidate where task_id = #{taskId} and reassigned_from_candidate_id = #{fromCandidateId} and user_id = #{toUserId} lock in share mode

select action_id, action_key, instance_id, task_id, candidate_id, action_type, operator_user_id, operator_name, operator_source, from_status, to_status, action_reason, request_id, action_snapshot, create_by, create_time, remark from approval_action_log where instance_id = #{instanceId} order by create_time, action_id

select action_id, action_key, instance_id, task_id, candidate_id, action_type, operator_user_id, operator_name, operator_source, from_status, to_status, action_reason, request_id, action_snapshot, create_by, create_time, remark from approval_action_log where action_key = #{actionKey}

select action_id, action_key, instance_id, task_id, candidate_id, action_type, operator_user_id, operator_name, operator_source, from_status, to_status, action_reason, request_id, action_snapshot, create_by, create_time, remark from approval_action_log where action_key = #{actionKey} lock in share mode

select outbox_id, event_key, instance_id, business_code, business_source, business_id, business_round, callback_action, callback_service, callback_code, payload, callback_status, retry_count, max_retry_count, next_retry_time, locked_by, lock_until, last_error_code, last_error_message, delivered_time, lock_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from approval_callback_outbox where instance_id = #{instanceId} order by outbox_id

select outbox_id, event_key, instance_id, business_code, business_source, business_id, business_round, callback_action, callback_service, callback_code, payload, callback_status, retry_count, max_retry_count, next_retry_time, locked_by, lock_until, last_error_code, last_error_message, delivered_time, lock_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from approval_callback_outbox where outbox_id = #{outboxId}

select outbox_id, event_key, instance_id, business_code, business_source, business_id, business_round, callback_action, callback_service, callback_code, payload, callback_status, retry_count, max_retry_count, next_retry_time, locked_by, lock_until, last_error_code, last_error_message, delivered_time, lock_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from approval_callback_outbox where ( callback_status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY') and (next_retry_time is null or next_retry_time <= sysdate()) ) or ( callback_status = 'PROCESSING' and lock_until < sysdate() ) order by outbox_id limit #{limit}
mapper.sql:
from approval_task t join approval_instance i on i.instance_id = t.instance_id join approval_task_candidate c on c.task_id = t.task_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = i.anchor_dept_id where c.user_id = #{userId} and c.candidate_status = 'PENDING' and t.task_status = 'PENDING' and i.status = 'RUNNING'
and (
(i.business_code = #{accessRule.businessCode} and (
(c.candidate_source_code is null or c.candidate_source_code not in
#{specialPermission} )
1 = 1
or c.candidate_source_code in
#{allowedSpecialPermission}
))
)
and 1 = 0
and #{query.category} = 'approval'
and i.business_source = #{query.source}
and #{query.type} = case i.business_code when 'OA_PURCHASE' then 'OA_PURCHASE_APPROVAL' when 'OA_REIMBURSEMENT' then 'OA_REIMBURSEMENT_APPROVAL' when 'INV_TRANSFER' then 'INV_TRANSFER_APPROVAL' when 'INV_STOCK_CHECK' then 'INV_STOCK_CHECK_APPROVAL' when 'HR_HEALTH_CERTIFICATE' then 'HR_HEALTH_CERT_REVIEW' else concat(i.business_code, '_APPROVAL') end
and (i.business_id like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or i.applicant_name like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or t.node_name like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or (case i.business_code when 'OA_PURCHASE' then 'OA采购申请' when 'OA_REIMBURSEMENT' then '费用报销' when 'INV_TRANSFER' then '调拨申请' when 'INV_STOCK_CHECK' then '库存盘点' when 'HR_HEALTH_CERTIFICATE' then '健康证审核' else '审批申请' end) like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))

case i.business_code when 'OA_PURCHASE' then 'OA_PURCHASE_APPROVAL' when 'OA_REIMBURSEMENT' then 'OA_REIMBURSEMENT_APPROVAL' when 'INV_TRANSFER' then 'INV_TRANSFER_APPROVAL' when 'INV_STOCK_CHECK' then 'INV_STOCK_CHECK_APPROVAL' when 'HR_HEALTH_CERTIFICATE' then 'HR_HEALTH_CERT_REVIEW' else concat(i.business_code, '_APPROVAL') end

order by t.activated_time asc, sort_business_id asc, i.business_source asc, sort_todo_type asc, t.task_id asc

order by t.activated_time asc, sort_business_id asc, i.business_source asc, sort_todo_type asc, t.task_id asc limit 5
mapper.insert: insert into approval_instance ( root_instance_id, previous_instance_id, template_id, business_code, business_source, business_id, business_subtype, business_round, idempotency_key, applicant_user_id, applicant_name, applicant_dept_id, applicant_dept_name, anchor_dept_id, anchor_dept_name, rule_id, rule_version_id, rule_version_no, business_snapshot, business_digest, route_snapshot, status, current_node_id, current_node_order, callback_status, approved_action_count, started_time, lock_version, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{rootInstanceId}, #{previousInstanceId}, #{templateId}, #{businessCode}, #{businessSource}, #{businessId}, #{businessSubtype}, #{businessRound}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{applicantUserId}, #{applicantName}, #{applicantDeptId}, #{applicantDeptName}, #{anchorDeptId}, #{anchorDeptName}, #{ruleId}, #{ruleVersionId}, #{ruleVersionNo}, #{businessSnapshot}, #{businessDigest}, #{routeSnapshot}, #{status}, #{currentNodeId}, #{currentNodeOrder}, #{callbackStatus}, #{approvedActionCount}, coalesce(#{startedTime}, sysdate()), 0, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )

insert into approval_task ( instance_id, node_id, node_order, node_code, node_name, task_status, approval_mode, required_count, completed_count, activated_time, completed_time, lock_version, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{instanceId}, #{nodeId}, #{nodeOrder}, #{nodeCode}, #{nodeName}, #{taskStatus}, #{approvalMode}, #{requiredCount}, #{completedCount}, #{activatedTime}, #{completedTime}, 0, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )

insert into approval_task_candidate ( task_id, instance_id, user_id, user_name, dept_id, dept_name, candidate_source_type, candidate_source_code, candidate_order, candidate_status, candidate_reason, reassigned_from_candidate_id, lock_version, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{taskId}, #{instanceId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{deptId}, #{deptName}, #{candidateSourceType}, #{candidateSourceCode}, #{candidateOrder}, #{candidateStatus}, #{candidateReason}, #{reassignedFromCandidateId}, 0, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )

insert into approval_action_log ( action_key, instance_id, task_id, candidate_id, action_type, operator_user_id, operator_name, operator_source, from_status, to_status, action_reason, request_id, action_snapshot, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{actionKey}, #{instanceId}, #{taskId}, #{candidateId}, #{actionType}, #{operatorUserId}, #{operatorName}, #{operatorSource}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{actionReason}, #{requestId}, #{actionSnapshot}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )

insert into approval_callback_outbox ( event_key, instance_id, business_code, business_source, business_id, business_round, callback_action, callback_service, callback_code, payload, callback_status, retry_count, max_retry_count, next_retry_time, lock_version, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{eventKey}, #{instanceId}, #{businessCode}, #{businessSource}, #{businessId}, #{businessRound}, #{callbackAction}, #{callbackService}, #{callbackCode}, #{payload}, #{callbackStatus}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, 0, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: update approval_instance set root_instance_id = instance_id where instance_id = #{instanceId} and root_instance_id is null

update approval_task_candidate set candidate_status = 'CANCELLED', candidate_reason = #{reason}, acted_time = sysdate(), lock_version = lock_version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and candidate_status = 'PENDING'
and candidate_id <> #{exceptCandidateId}

update approval_task_candidate set candidate_status = 'CANCELLED', candidate_reason = #{reason}, acted_time = sysdate(), lock_version = lock_version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where instance_id = #{instanceId} and candidate_status = 'PENDING'

update approval_callback_outbox set callback_status = 'PROCESSING', locked_by = #{worker}, lock_until = #{lockUntil}, lock_version = lock_version + 1, update_by = #{worker}, update_time = sysdate() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and lock_version = #{expectedVersion} and ((callback_status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY') and (next_retry_time is null or next_retry_time <= sysdate())) or (callback_status = 'PROCESSING' and lock_until < sysdate()))

update approval_callback_outbox set callback_status = 'SUCCEEDED', delivered_time = sysdate(), locked_by = null, lock_until = null, last_error_code = null, last_error_message = null, lock_version = lock_version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and callback_status = 'PROCESSING' and lock_version = #{expectedVersion}

update approval_callback_outbox set callback_status = #{status}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, locked_by = null, lock_until = null, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, lock_version = lock_version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and callback_status = 'PROCESSING' and lock_version = #{expectedVersion}

update approval_callback_outbox set callback_status = 'PENDING', retry_count = 0, next_retry_time = sysdate(), locked_by = null, lock_until = null, last_error_code = null, last_error_message = null, lock_version = lock_version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and callback_status in ('DEAD', 'RETRY') and lock_version = #{expectedVersion}
